ValidationRule.description: Agent closed case as "No defect" but a defect has been found and rectified before.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = "KYC_QA", ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Status__c, "No Defect"), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Defects_Rectified__c, "Yes"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Customer_Details__c , "No"), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_MiddleNameCheck__c , "No"), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Selfie_Comparison_Match__c , "No"), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_PO_Box__c , "No"), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Address_Valid__c , "No"), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_ID_Legible__c, "No"), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Customer_Photo_Modified__c , "No"), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_ID_Not_Picture__c , "No"), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Security_Features__c , "No") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The KYC check for this case is already completed with a defect, you cannot select No Defect.
